title: Sunday Blues Jams @ Pub 61
event_description: Weekly blues jam sessions hosted by Lowcountry Blues Connection. Open to all skill levels. Musicians sign up to jam - sit-in friendly with rotating cast of accomplished local musicians. Free to attend - tip the performers.
venue_address: 2366 Ashley River Road West Ashley SC
event_venue_information:
Pub 61 - Charleston's Blues Jam Destination

Pub 61 located at 2366 Ashley River Road in West Ashley is a key venue for blues jam sessions in the Charleston area. The venue hosts Lowcountry Blues Connection jams on select Sundays creating a gathering place for blues musicians and fans in the Lowcountry.

Sunday Blues Jams

Lowcountry Blues Connection hosts blues jam sessions at Pub 61 on the first third and fourth Sundays of each month from 5-9pm. These sessions bring together accomplished local musicians and welcome sit-in players of all skill levels. The jam format allows musicians to collaborate spontaneously and audiences to experience authentic blues music.

Lowcountry Blues Connection

Lowcountry Blues Connection is the organizing body behind the Charleston area blues community. Members perform regularly around town at various venues including Smokey's Place Brickyard Main Street Steel Horse and more. The organization keeps the blues tradition alive in Charleston and maintains an active community of blues players.

Music Style

The jam sessions feature authentic blues in all its forms. The rotating cast of musicians ensures variety from week to week - audiences never know exactly which players will show up making each session unique. The focus is on blues but the accomplished musicians can adapt to different styles and requests.

Venue Atmosphere

Pub 61 provides a casual neighborhood setting for the jams. The venue functions as a true gathering place rather than a formal concert hall. The free admission policy with tip-based support for performers keeps the focus on the music and community rather than commercialism.
